justification: Config-only change to applicability provenance for four Canterbury-Bankstown chapters. The served value (v2_applicable_dev_types = ['ALL']) does not change; only v2_dev_type_source moves config_silent -> config_declined after the retag. No serving code, no schema. Also widens the OC-17 checker so a stated public exception still counts as live once its rows move from undecided to config_declined.

break_it.scenario: A decline is added without the chapter's own words, so 'declined' becomes the new silent default.
break_it.what_happens: DQ-114 reads 0 while nobody read the chapter.
break_it.how: test_a_declined_use_class_quotes_its_own_chapter requires 'verbatim' and 'DECLINED' and refuses the plan-level Chapter 1.1 sentence; tests/test_scope_evidence_declared.py requires evidence for every declined key. Quotes were read from the council PDFs (r2_public_pdf_url) on 2026-10-04.

break_it.scenario: A future edit removes scope_declined from one chapter.
break_it.what_happens: The key silently returns to config_silent and DQ-114 rises again.
break_it.how: Mutation run: removing scope_declined from chapter_10_2_schools fails 2 tests (the declined assertion and the evidence-without-declaration check).
break_it.repro: delete the scope_declined line on chapter_10_2_schools and run the two files above

break_it.scenario: Declining is used to narrow, hiding rules from properties.
break_it.what_happens: Rows disappear from property answers for other development types.
break_it.how: _resolve returns ['ALL'] for a declined key; the test asserts applicable_dev_types == ['ALL'] for all four chapters, so no row can be hidden by this change.

break_it.scenario: After the retag the CB 10.2-10.5 rows become config_declined and leave DQ-114's split.
break_it.what_happens: Before this change OC-17 would report the true public caveat as stale and outreach would drop to 16 of 17.
break_it.how: compute() reads _DECLINED_SQL and subtracts it from the stale set; test_exception_whose_rows_were_DECLINED_is_not_stale; a declined row for a different key does not rescue it (second test). Mutation removing the subtraction fails 1 test.

post_merge.db_reset: No schema change. The production retag (scripts/retag_applicability_slug_docids.py --councils canterbury_bankstown) must run after merge from a worktree at merged origin/main: dry run first, then --apply --expect-narrowings 0 with the user's go. Expected: 21 served keys config_silent -> config_declined, 0 narrowings.
post_merge.manual_verify: After the retag: python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-114 reads 0; then flip DQ-114 declared state in .claude/dq_checks.json and the tracker in a small PR.

pre_impl.existing_data: Reused the existing scope_declined mechanism (migrations/081, ApplicabilityTagger._resolve) already used by chapter_10_6_commercial_land_uses in the same file; no new key, no new code path.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The prompt's DQ-114=21 was re-measured live 2026-10-04: exactly 7+2+3+9 keys on chapters 10.2/10.3/10.4/10.5, all dev-type, all config_silent. The config's own comment had called them a stated exception; that predated config_declined.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Targeted: 4 config entries gain scope_declined + an applicable_dev_types evidence sentence; no other entry changes. The retag after merge rewrites only v2_dev_type_source on the 21 rows.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Quotes read from the council PDFs at r2_public_pdf_url (dcp_chapter_registry, is_active = TRUE) with PyMuPDF; page numbers are PDF page indices.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: None to the served answer: v2_applicable_dev_types stays ['ALL'] before and after. The change is to the audit trail: these rows stop claiming nobody read their chapter.

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest tests/test_canterbury_bankstown_applicability.py tests/test_scope_evidence_declared.py -q ; after the retag: python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-114 ; python scripts/outreach_scoped_councils.py
falsifiable_check.fails_when: Any of the four chapters resolves to config_silent or config_all, or declines without quoting its own chapter; DQ-114 > 0 after the retag.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Mutation: removing scope_declined from chapter_10_2_schools failed 2 tests (declined assertion + evidence-without-declaration). Restored: 109 applicability tests pass. DQ-114 live = 21 before the retag. OC-17 checker live: PASS, 12 of 18, before the retag.

functions.name: _resolve
functions.input: existing, unmodified function -- receives the four changed config entries
functions.output: (['ALL'], 'config_declined') for applicable_dev_types on all four chapters, asserted by test_what_cannot_be_expressed_is_DECLINED_not_asserted
functions.if_none: entry None -> (['ALL'], 'no_config'); scope_declined None -> treated as empty tuple, falls through to the key check

functions.name: compute
functions.output: (reasons per council, registry names, problems); an exception is stale only if it matches no undecided AND no declined served row
functions.if_none: no declined rows -> empty set, behaviour identical to before; exceptions list empty -> nothing excused
